title: 巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘
summary: 透過 24 個概念工序認識三階船閘、節水池、滾動閘門、土建與控制介面，連結通航能力、淡水資源與維護證據。
summaryEn: Use 24 conceptual steps to connect three-chamber locks, water-saving basins, rolling gates and civil-control interfaces with navigation, freshwater and maintenance evidence.
scope: 以公開一次資料為背景的原創工程判讀課程；每步在紙上或數位示意模型中完成。自設數值、構形與工序不得當成原工程的設計、施工、設備操作或驗收程序。
scopeEn: Original engineering interpretation exercises grounded in public primary sources. Complete each step on paper or in a schematic digital model. Invented values, geometry and sequences are not the original project’s design, construction, operating or acceptance procedures.

stages.title: 通航需求與水量邊界
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「通航需求與水量邊界」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on navigation requirements and water balance, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 畫出兩洋與湖泊的高程關係
steps.titleEn: Map ocean and lake level relationships
steps.objective: 理解船閘如何連接不同水位。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how locks connect different water levels.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫海洋、閘室及加通湖三類區域；2. 用高程線區分水面；3. 將船移動路線與水移動路線分色。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw ocean, lock chambers and Gatun Lake; 2. distinguish water levels with elevation lines; 3. separate vessel and water routes by color.
steps.observation: 船的前進方向與水流方向不是必然相同。
steps.observationEn: Vessel direction and water-flow direction are not necessarily the same.
steps.failure: 船閘是把海水連續向前推動船舶的單向水管。
steps.failureEn: A lock is a one-way pipe continuously pushing ships forward with seawater.
steps.check: 提交含兩類路徑和水位基準的概念剖面。
steps.checkEn: Submit a conceptual section with two route types and a water-level datum.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 浮船的升降依靠所在水面的變化；閘室是調整水位的空間。
knowledge.textEn: A floating vessel rises or falls with its water surface; a lock chamber provides the changing-level space.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 水位圖描述功能概念，不是實際閘門開閉或通航程序。
knowledge.textEn: The level diagram explains function and is not an actual gate or transit procedure.

quiz.question: 審查「畫出兩洋與湖泊的高程關係」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Map ocean and lake level relationships”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 船的前進方向與水流方向不是必然相同。
船閘是把海水連續向前推動船舶的單向水管。
船舶高度由閘門馬達直接托舉，不受閘室水面影響。
optionsEn: Vessel direction and water-flow direction are not necessarily the same.
A lock is a one-way pipe continuously pushing ships forward with seawater.
Gate motors directly lift vessel elevation independently of chamber water level.
quiz.explanation: 浮船的升降依靠所在水面的變化；閘室是調整水位的空間。 水位圖描述功能概念，不是實際閘門開閉或通航程序。
quiz.explanationEn: A floating vessel rises or falls with its water surface; a lock chamber provides the changing-level space. The level diagram explains function and is not an actual gate or transit procedure.

steps.title: 比較原船閘與擴建船閘
steps.objective: 避免把兩代設備與尺寸混用。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid mixing two generations of equipment and dimensions.
steps.instruction: 1. 分別建立原閘與新閘資料卡；2. 標示人字閘門與滾動閘門；3. 記錄每個尺寸所描述的是閘室還是船舶。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Create separate original-lock and expanded-lock records; 2. distinguish miter and rolling gates; 3. identify whether each dimension describes chamber or vessel.
steps.observation: 閘室尺寸與可通航船舶限制不是完全相同的量。
steps.observationEn: Chamber dimensions and permitted vessel limits are not identical quantities.
steps.failure: 把新閘室寬度直接當成任何情境下的允許船寬。
steps.failureEn: Treat new-chamber width as the permissible vessel beam in every circumstance.
steps.check: 輸出含設備世代與資料邊界的比較表。
steps.checkEn: Provide a comparison with equipment generation and data boundaries.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 擴建工程增加新的通航設施；原閘與新閘採用不同閘門及水管理配置。
knowledge.textEn: The expansion added facilities with gate and water-management arrangements different from the original locks.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 船舶限制需額外考慮通航要求，不能只從土建空間推算。
knowledge.textEn: Vessel limits involve navigation requirements beyond the physical civil-work space.

quiz.question: 審查「比較原船閘與擴建船閘」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Compare original and expanded locks”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 把新閘室寬度直接當成任何情境下的允許船寬。
閘室尺寸與可通航船舶限制不是完全相同的量。
原運河人字門與新閘滾動門具有相同運動幾何。
optionsEn: Treat new-chamber width as the permissible vessel beam in every circumstance.
Chamber dimensions and permitted vessel limits are not identical quantities.
Original miter gates and new rolling gates have identical movement geometry.
quiz.explanation: 擴建工程增加新的通航設施；原閘與新閘採用不同閘門及水管理配置。 船舶限制需額外考慮通航要求，不能只從土建空間推算。
quiz.explanationEn: The expansion added facilities with gate and water-management arrangements different from the original locks. Vessel limits involve navigation requirements beyond the physical civil-work space.

steps.title: 拆出三階閘室系統
steps.objective: 辨識單一閘室與整組船閘的關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish one chamber from a complete lock flight.
steps.instruction: 1. 串接三個概念閘室；2. 標出相鄰水位邊界；3. 列出每個邊界需協調的水力及設備資訊。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Connect three conceptual chambers; 2. mark adjacent water-level boundaries; 3. list hydraulic and equipment information needed at each boundary.
steps.observation: 一個閘室的狀態可能改變相鄰區的可用條件。
steps.observationEn: The state of one chamber can affect conditions available to neighboring sections.
steps.failure: 三個閘室可以忽略共同邊界而各自獨立任意運作。
steps.failureEn: Three chambers can operate arbitrarily and independently without shared boundaries.
steps.check: 繳交三室及四個邊界的系統圖。
steps.checkEn: Provide a three-chamber diagram with four boundaries.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 串聯系統共享水位與通航介面，局部功能成立不代表整組時序相容。
knowledge.textEn: Series systems share level and navigation interfaces; local function does not establish compatible system timing.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本圖只表達依賴關係，不給出真實操作順序或設定值。
knowledge.textEn: The diagram expresses dependencies without real operating sequences or settings.

quiz.question: 審查「拆出三階閘室系統」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Decompose the three-chamber system”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 三個閘室可以忽略共同邊界而各自獨立任意運作。
相鄰閘室的水位邊界對彼此沒有影響。
一個閘室的狀態可能改變相鄰區的可用條件。
optionsEn: Three chambers can operate arbitrarily and independently without shared boundaries.
Adjacent chamber-level boundaries have no mutual effect.
The state of one chamber can affect conditions available to neighboring sections.
quiz.explanation: 串聯系統共享水位與通航介面，局部功能成立不代表整組時序相容。 本圖只表達依賴關係，不給出真實操作順序或設定值。
quiz.explanationEn: Series systems share level and navigation interfaces; local function does not establish compatible system timing. The diagram expresses dependencies without real operating sequences or settings.

steps.title: 建立一個完整的水量邊界
steps.objective: 把閘室、節水池與外部水源放入守恆框架。
steps.objectiveEn: Place chambers, saving basins and external water in a conservation framework.
steps.instruction: 1. 選定包住閘室與節水池的邊界；2. 列出進入、流出及儲水變化；3. 用自設體積核對平衡並標示未計入項。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Enclose a chamber and its basins in a boundary; 2. list inflow, outflow and storage change; 3. reconcile invented volumes and identify omitted terms.
steps.observation: 內部回用流量不應再次計為從湖泊新增取水。
steps.observationEn: Internal reuse should not be counted again as new withdrawal from the lake.
steps.failure: 把每一段內部水流都加進外部耗水量。
steps.failureEn: Add every internal transfer to external water consumption.
steps.check: 提交一次守恆計算與明確的系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Submit one conservation calculation with an explicit system boundary.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 水量守恆取決於邊界定義，內部轉移在整體帳中應相互抵消。
knowledge.textEn: Water conservation depends on boundary definition; internal transfers cancel in the overall balance.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 自設例子不對應真實航次用水，實況還需水位及營運資料。
knowledge.textEn: The invented example is not real transit consumption, which requires level and operating data.

quiz.question: 審查「建立一個完整的水量邊界」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Define a complete water-balance boundary”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 內部回用流量不應再次計為從湖泊新增取水。
把每一段內部水流都加進外部耗水量。
內部轉移與外部取水在任何邊界下都是同一項。
optionsEn: Internal reuse should not be counted again as new withdrawal from the lake.
Add every internal transfer to external water consumption.
Internal transfer and external withdrawal are identical under every boundary definition.
quiz.explanation: 水量守恆取決於邊界定義，內部轉移在整體帳中應相互抵消。 自設例子不對應真實航次用水，實況還需水位及營運資料。
quiz.explanationEn: Water conservation depends on boundary definition; internal transfers cancel in the overall balance. The invented example is not real transit consumption, which requires level and operating data.

steps.title: 辨認節水比例的分母
steps.titleEn: Identify the denominator in a saving ratio
steps.objective: 區分回用比例、耗水差異與總取水。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish reuse fraction, consumption difference and total withdrawal.
steps.instruction: 1. 寫出原始取水及回用的假想數據；2. 用兩個不同分母計算百分比；3. 說明為何不能把百分比直接相加。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Write hypothetical withdrawal and reuse values; 2. calculate percentages using two denominators; 3. explain why those percentages cannot simply be added.
steps.observation: 節水百分比需要交代比較對象與分母才具有意義。
steps.observationEn: A saving percentage needs a comparison basis and denominator to be meaningful.
steps.failure: 兩份資料都寫節水就可把百分比相加得到總效果。
steps.failureEn: Two reported saving percentages can be added to obtain total benefit.
steps.check: 輸出每個百分比的公式、分母及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Provide a formula, denominator and scope for each percentage.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 回用同一水體與減少外部取水是相關但不相同的指標。
knowledge.textEn: Reusing water and reducing external withdrawal are related but distinct metrics.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 官方發表的回用性能應連同測試或設計背景閱讀，不能推成每次航行保證。
knowledge.textEn: Published reuse performance needs its design or test context and is not a guarantee for every transit.

quiz.question: 審查「辨認節水比例的分母」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Identify the denominator in a saving ratio”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 兩份資料都寫節水就可把百分比相加得到總效果。
節水百分比需要交代比較對象與分母才具有意義。
同樣百分比在不同分母下代表相同節水體積。
optionsEn: Two reported saving percentages can be added to obtain total benefit.
A saving percentage needs a comparison basis and denominator to be meaningful.
The same percentage under different denominators means the same saved volume.
quiz.explanation: 回用同一水體與減少外部取水是相關但不相同的指標。 官方發表的回用性能應連同測試或設計背景閱讀，不能推成每次航行保證。
quiz.explanationEn: Reusing water and reducing external withdrawal are related but distinct metrics. Published reuse performance needs its design or test context and is not a guarantee for every transit.

steps.title: 審查通航與水資源需求
steps.objective: 理解航運服務與流域其他用途的共同依賴。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand shared dependence of shipping and other watershed uses.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫通航、居民用水及湖泊蓄水三個需求節點；2. 連到共同水源；3. 列出一項增加通航能力仍不能回答的資源問題。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw navigation, public-water and storage demand nodes; 2. connect them to shared water; 3. identify a resource question increased navigation capacity cannot answer.
steps.observation: 更大的船閘不能單獨保證任何乾旱條件下都有足夠淡水。
steps.observationEn: Larger locks alone cannot guarantee sufficient freshwater under every drought condition.
steps.failure: 增加閘室尺寸會自動增加流域可用水量。
steps.failureEn: Increasing chamber size automatically increases available watershed water.
steps.check: 繳交通航、儲水及供水需求矩陣。
steps.checkEn: Provide a navigation, storage and water-supply requirements matrix.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 工程容量與自然資源供給屬不同約束，兩者需在同一系統範圍下協調。
knowledge.textEn: Engineering capacity and natural supply are different constraints requiring coordination within one system boundary.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本課程不推定當前水位、通航限額或政策；這些需查最新營運公告。
knowledge.textEn: The course does not infer current levels, transit limits or policy, which require current operator notices.

quiz.question: 審查「審查通航與水資源需求」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Review navigation and water-resource needs”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 增加閘室尺寸會自動增加流域可用水量。
自然降雨與工程容量是可以互相替代的相同約束。
更大的船閘不能單獨保證任何乾旱條件下都有足夠淡水。
optionsEn: Increasing chamber size automatically increases available watershed water.
Natural rainfall and engineering capacity are interchangeable constraints.
Larger locks alone cannot guarantee sufficient freshwater under every drought condition.
quiz.explanation: 工程容量與自然資源供給屬不同約束，兩者需在同一系統範圍下協調。 本課程不推定當前水位、通航限額或政策；這些需查最新營運公告。
quiz.explanationEn: Engineering capacity and natural supply are different constraints requiring coordination within one system boundary. The course does not infer current levels, transit limits or policy, which require current operator notices.

stages.title: 閘室土建與大型閘門
stages.titleEn: Lock civil works and large gates
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「閘室土建與大型閘門」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on lock civil works and large gates, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 拆出開挖、地盤與閘室底板
steps.titleEn: Separate excavation, ground and lock floor
steps.objective: 辨識擋土、地下水與承載的不同問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish retaining, groundwater and bearing questions.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫概念基坑與閘室底板；2. 標出土水壓與結構自重方向；3. 分別列出地盤、地下水及結構證據需求。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a conceptual excavation and lock floor; 2. mark earth, water and self-weight directions; 3. list ground, groundwater and structural evidence separately.
steps.observation: 水位改變會影響地下結構受力，不能只考慮上部船閘重量。
steps.observationEn: Water-level changes affect underground structural actions beyond the weight of the lock.
steps.failure: 底板很厚就可以忽略地下水及地盤變形。
steps.failureEn: A thick floor slab makes groundwater and ground deformation irrelevant.
steps.check: 提交一張含水壓及地盤反力的概念剖面。
steps.checkEn: Submit a conceptual section with water pressure and ground reactions.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 基坑與完工閘室具有不同水位及支承狀態，應分開建模。
knowledge.textEn: Excavations and completed locks have different water levels and supports and require separate models.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本步不提供降水、支撐或開挖方案，而是列出必須具備的設計證據。
knowledge.textEn: This step supplies no dewatering, support or excavation scheme; it identifies necessary design evidence.

quiz.question: 審查「拆出開挖、地盤與閘室底板」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate excavation, ground and lock floor”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 水位改變會影響地下結構受力，不能只考慮上部船閘重量。
底板很厚就可以忽略地下水及地盤變形。
基坑與完工閘室可以假定永遠具有同一水位與支承。
optionsEn: Water-level changes affect underground structural actions beyond the weight of the lock.
A thick floor slab makes groundwater and ground deformation irrelevant.
Excavations and completed locks can always share identical levels and support conditions.
quiz.explanation: 基坑與完工閘室具有不同水位及支承狀態，應分開建模。 本步不提供降水、支撐或開挖方案，而是列出必須具備的設計證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Excavations and completed locks have different water levels and supports and require separate models. This step supplies no dewatering, support or excavation scheme; it identifies necessary design evidence.

steps.title: 理解大體積混凝土的溫度歷程
steps.objective: 將材料強度與溫度變形分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate material strength from thermal deformation.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫一塊概念厚牆的中心與表面；2. 自設兩條溫度曲線；3. 比較溫差、約束與裂縫風險之間的關係。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw the core and surface of a conceptual thick wall; 2. create two temperature histories; 3. relate temperature difference, restraint and cracking risk.
steps.observation: 強度資料合格不會自動消除受約束溫度變形的問題。
steps.observationEn: Acceptable strength data do not automatically eliminate restrained thermal-deformation issues.
steps.failure: 混凝土越厚就一定越不需考慮內外溫差。
steps.failureEn: Thicker concrete necessarily needs less consideration of internal temperature differences.
steps.check: 輸出溫度歷程與約束位置的配對圖。
steps.checkEn: Provide paired temperature histories and restraint locations.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 水化產熱、散熱及約束會共同影響溫度應力，不能只看單點最高溫。
knowledge.textEn: Hydration heat, cooling and restraint jointly influence thermal stress, beyond one peak temperature.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 課程的溫度曲線是教學自設，不提供實際混凝土配比或養護設定。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching temperature curves provide no actual mix design or curing settings.

quiz.question: 審查「理解大體積混凝土的溫度歷程」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Understand mass-concrete temperature history”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 混凝土越厚就一定越不需考慮內外溫差。
強度資料合格不會自動消除受約束溫度變形的問題。
只記最高溫度就能完整描述受約束溫度應力。
optionsEn: Thicker concrete necessarily needs less consideration of internal temperature differences.
Acceptable strength data do not automatically eliminate restrained thermal-deformation issues.
One maximum temperature completely describes restrained thermal stress.
quiz.explanation: 水化產熱、散熱及約束會共同影響溫度應力，不能只看單點最高溫。 課程的溫度曲線是教學自設，不提供實際混凝土配比或養護設定。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydration heat, cooling and restraint jointly influence thermal stress, beyond one peak temperature. Teaching temperature curves provide no actual mix design or curing settings.

steps.title: 核對施工縫與止水介面
steps.objective: 理解連續防水依賴局部接合品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how continuous water control depends on local joints.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫底板、牆及一條概念施工縫；2. 標出水的可能穿越路徑；3. 建立位置、材料及隱蔽檢查的追溯表。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw floor, wall and a conceptual construction joint; 2. mark possible water crossings; 3. create a location, material and concealed-inspection record.
steps.observation: 大面積混凝土完整不等於每一條接縫都已驗證水密。
steps.observationEn: Intact bulk concrete does not establish watertightness at every joint.
steps.failure: 表面無裂痕就能證明所有隱蔽止水構件正確安裝。
steps.failureEn: A crack-free surface proves correct installation of all concealed waterstops.
steps.check: 提交至少三類接縫證據與各自限制。
steps.checkEn: Provide at least three joint-evidence types with their limitations.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 防水介面是連續路徑問題，局部缺口可能主導整體滲漏。
knowledge.textEn: Water control is a continuity problem in which a local gap can dominate leakage.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 照片可協助追溯位置，但材料識別與施工紀錄仍需各自保留。
knowledge.textEn: Photos help trace locations, while material identification and installation records remain separate needs.

quiz.question: 審查「核對施工縫與止水介面」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Review joints and waterstops”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 表面無裂痕就能證明所有隱蔽止水構件正確安裝。
隱蔽止水細節能由完工外觀唯一推定。
大面積混凝土完整不等於每一條接縫都已驗證水密。
optionsEn: A crack-free surface proves correct installation of all concealed waterstops.
Concealed waterstop details can be uniquely inferred from finished appearance.
Intact bulk concrete does not establish watertightness at every joint.
quiz.explanation: 防水介面是連續路徑問題，局部缺口可能主導整體滲漏。 照片可協助追溯位置，但材料識別與施工紀錄仍需各自保留。
quiz.explanationEn: Water control is a continuity problem in which a local gap can dominate leakage. Photos help trace locations, while material identification and installation records remain separate needs.

steps.title: 辨認滾動閘門的空間包絡
steps.objective: 區分閘門封水、移動及檢修空間。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish sealing, movement and maintenance spaces.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫閘室與側向閘門凹槽；2. 以虛線標出概念移動包絡；3. 列出結構、驅動及維護三類介面。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a chamber and lateral gate recess; 2. mark a conceptual movement envelope; 3. list structural, drive and maintenance interfaces.
steps.observation: 閘門能放入凹槽不等於移動、密封及維護條件全部成立。
steps.observationEn: A gate fitting its recess does not establish movement, sealing and maintenance requirements.
steps.failure: 只要閘門外形吻合開口，所有機械介面便可省略。
steps.failureEn: A gate outline matching the opening makes every mechanical interface unnecessary.
steps.check: 輸出三種空間與介面分色的平面圖。
steps.checkEn: Produce a plan separating three spaces and interface types by color.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 滾動門的側向移動與原運河人字門的旋轉不同，不能沿用相同幾何模型。
knowledge.textEn: Rolling-gate translation differs from original miter-gate rotation and needs a different geometric model.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本圖不提供運動速度、驅動力或現場維護操作值。
knowledge.textEn: The diagram supplies no movement speeds, drive forces or field maintenance settings.

quiz.question: 審查「辨認滾動閘門的空間包絡」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Identify rolling-gate movement envelopes”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 閘門能放入凹槽不等於移動、密封及維護條件全部成立。
只要閘門外形吻合開口，所有機械介面便可省略。
滾動門的檢修空間可由封水位置的外框直接代替。
optionsEn: A gate fitting its recess does not establish movement, sealing and maintenance requirements.
A gate outline matching the opening makes every mechanical interface unnecessary.
A rolling gate’s closed outline directly substitutes for its maintenance space.
quiz.explanation: 滾動門的側向移動與原運河人字門的旋轉不同，不能沿用相同幾何模型。 本圖不提供運動速度、驅動力或現場維護操作值。
quiz.explanationEn: Rolling-gate translation differs from original miter-gate rotation and needs a different geometric model. The diagram supplies no movement speeds, drive forces or field maintenance settings.

steps.title: 追溯大型閘門製造與運輸
steps.titleEn: Trace gate fabrication and transport evidence
steps.objective: 理解製造完成與現地適合安裝的差別。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish fabrication completion from site installation readiness.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫製造、海運、暫存及安裝四個資料節點；2. 每段列出幾何與狀態紀錄；3. 加入到場損傷及版本不符的假想例子。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw fabrication, sea transport, storage and installation records; 2. list geometry and condition evidence at each stage; 3. introduce hypothetical arrival damage and revision mismatch.
steps.observation: 出廠驗證不會自動覆蓋運輸及到場後的狀態變化。
steps.observationEn: Factory verification does not automatically cover transport and post-arrival condition changes.
steps.failure: 供應商出廠合格即可刪除所有到場介面複核。
steps.failureEn: Supplier factory acceptance eliminates every arrival-interface review.
steps.check: 提交一件構件從出廠到移交的資料鏈。
steps.checkEn: Provide one component’s evidence chain from factory to handover.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 大型構件的品質包含幾何、材料、運輸支承及狀態追溯，不能只看重量。
knowledge.textEn: Large-component quality involves geometry, material, transport support and condition traceability, not weight alone.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 歷史運輸照片可說明尺度及物流背景，不是可複製的吊運計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Historical transport photographs explain scale and logistics context, not a reusable lifting plan.

quiz.question: 審查「追溯大型閘門製造與運輸」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Trace gate fabrication and transport evidence”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 供應商出廠合格即可刪除所有到場介面複核。
出廠驗證不會自動覆蓋運輸及到場後的狀態變化。
大型構件重量一致就表示運輸後幾何與狀態未改變。
optionsEn: Supplier factory acceptance eliminates every arrival-interface review.
Factory verification does not automatically cover transport and post-arrival condition changes.
Equal component weight proves geometry and condition are unchanged after transport.
quiz.explanation: 大型構件的品質包含幾何、材料、運輸支承及狀態追溯，不能只看重量。 歷史運輸照片可說明尺度及物流背景，不是可複製的吊運計畫。
quiz.explanationEn: Large-component quality involves geometry, material, transport support and condition traceability, not weight alone. Historical transport photographs explain scale and logistics context, not a reusable lifting plan.

steps.title: 審查閘門—土建的公差鏈
steps.objective: 把零件尺寸轉成整體介面配合。
steps.objectiveEn: Translate component dimensions into assembled interface compatibility.
steps.instruction: 1. 自設閘門、凹槽及導向三個尺寸；2. 分別加入同向及反向偏差；3. 比較剩餘間隙並記錄共同基準。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Invent gate, recess and guide dimensions; 2. apply same-direction and opposite-direction deviations; 3. compare remaining clearances under one datum.
steps.observation: 各零件在自有公差內仍可能組成不相容的介面。
steps.observationEn: Individually in-tolerance parts can still create an incompatible assembly.
steps.failure: 每個供應商都合格就代表組合間隙一定合適。
steps.failureEn: Every supplier passing guarantees acceptable assembly clearance.
steps.check: 輸出有單位、基準及最不利組合的公差表。
steps.checkEn: Provide a tolerance table with units, datums and adverse combinations.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 配合由多項尺寸共同決定，系統性偏差與不同基準會增加閉合問題。
knowledge.textEn: Fit depends on multiple dimensions; systematic bias and inconsistent datums can worsen closure.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 自設間隙只用於理解累積，不是實際閘門可接受偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Invented clearances explain accumulation and are not permissible real-gate tolerances.

quiz.question: 審查「審查閘門—土建的公差鏈」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Review gate-to-civil tolerance chains”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 每個供應商都合格就代表組合間隙一定合適。
相同方向的公差一定會互相抵消並增加間隙。
各零件在自有公差內仍可能組成不相容的介面。
optionsEn: Every supplier passing guarantees acceptable assembly clearance.
Same-direction tolerances necessarily cancel and increase clearance.
Individually in-tolerance parts can still create an incompatible assembly.
quiz.explanation: 配合由多項尺寸共同決定，系統性偏差與不同基準會增加閉合問題。 自設間隙只用於理解累積，不是實際閘門可接受偏差。
quiz.explanationEn: Fit depends on multiple dimensions; systematic bias and inconsistent datums can worsen closure. Invented clearances explain accumulation and are not permissible real-gate tolerances.

stages.title: 水力與功能介面驗證
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「水力與功能介面驗證」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on hydraulic and functional interfaces, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 畫出節水池的儲水層級
steps.objective: 理解多池系統如何提供不同儲水位置。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand distinct storage levels in a multiple-basin system.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫一個閘室及三個概念節水池；2. 標出水面高程及連通關係；3. 將內部轉移與外部供水箭頭分開。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw one chamber and three conceptual saving basins; 2. mark levels and connections; 3. separate internal transfers from external supply.
steps.observation: 節水池回用作用需要水位及連通條件，不能只靠池子的存在。
steps.observationEn: Basin reuse requires level and connection conditions, not merely the presence of basins.
steps.failure: 新增池子但不核對高程及連通仍能保證相同節水效果。
steps.failureEn: Adding basins without checking levels and connections guarantees identical savings.
steps.check: 提交有高程基準的池室連通圖。
steps.checkEn: Submit a basin-chamber connection map with a level datum.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 水的可轉移量受幾何與水位差影響，儲水總容量不能直接當成每次回用量。
knowledge.textEn: Transferable water depends on geometry and head difference; total storage is not automatically reused per cycle.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本步僅建立水力概念，不提供真實節水池閥門時序。
knowledge.textEn: This step builds hydraulic concepts and provides no actual basin-valve sequence.

quiz.question: 審查「畫出節水池的儲水層級」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Draw the water-saving basin levels”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 節水池回用作用需要水位及連通條件，不能只靠池子的存在。
新增池子但不核對高程及連通仍能保證相同節水效果。
節水池總容量就是每個航次必定回用的水量。
optionsEn: Basin reuse requires level and connection conditions, not merely the presence of basins.
Adding basins without checking levels and connections guarantees identical savings.
Total basin capacity equals water necessarily reused on every transit.
quiz.explanation: 水的可轉移量受幾何與水位差影響，儲水總容量不能直接當成每次回用量。 本步僅建立水力概念，不提供真實節水池閥門時序。
quiz.explanationEn: Transferable water depends on geometry and head difference; total storage is not automatically reused per cycle. This step builds hydraulic concepts and provides no actual basin-valve sequence.

steps.title: 區分靜水壓與流動瞬變
steps.objective: 避免用靜止水面推定所有充排水現象。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid inferring every filling or emptying effect from still-water levels.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫靜止水面下的壓力趨勢；2. 另畫概念管路流量變化；3. 分列穩態、瞬變及結構反應三種問題。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Sketch pressure trends beneath a still surface; 2. separately sketch changing conduit flow; 3. distinguish steady, transient and structural-response questions.
steps.observation: 相同起訖水位不保證過程中的流量及壓力歷程相同。
steps.observationEn: Identical initial and final levels do not guarantee identical flow or pressure histories.
steps.failure: 只知道最後水位即可證明整段充水過程沒有瞬變問題。
steps.failureEn: Knowing the final level proves the filling process has no transient issues.
steps.check: 繳交狀態量與過程量的比較表。
steps.checkEn: Provide a comparison of state quantities and process quantities.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 靜水壓描述近乎靜止條件；改變流速涉及動量及時間效應。
knowledge.textEn: Hydrostatic pressure describes near-stationary conditions; changing velocity introduces momentum and time effects.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 概念曲線不設定流速、開關速率或設備極限，也不取代水力試驗。
knowledge.textEn: Conceptual curves set no velocities, actuation rates or equipment limits and do not replace hydraulic tests.

quiz.question: 審查「區分靜水壓與流動瞬變」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Distinguish hydrostatic and transient effects”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 只知道最後水位即可證明整段充水過程沒有瞬變問題。
相同起訖水位不保證過程中的流量及壓力歷程相同。
靜水壓圖已包含全部流速變化的時間效應。
optionsEn: Knowing the final level proves the filling process has no transient issues.
Identical initial and final levels do not guarantee identical flow or pressure histories.
A hydrostatic-pressure diagram already includes all time effects of changing velocity.
quiz.explanation: 靜水壓描述近乎靜止條件；改變流速涉及動量及時間效應。 概念曲線不設定流速、開關速率或設備極限，也不取代水力試驗。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydrostatic pressure describes near-stationary conditions; changing velocity introduces momentum and time effects. Conceptual curves set no velocities, actuation rates or equipment limits and do not replace hydraulic tests.

steps.title: 檢查船舶包絡與水位情境
steps.titleEn: Check vessel envelopes across level cases
steps.objective: 把吃水、浮體及閘室幾何分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate draft, floating-body geometry and chamber dimensions.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫一個假想船體及水線；2. 比較兩個自設水位情境；3. 將船舶尺度與通航核准資料分成不同欄。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a hypothetical hull and waterline; 2. compare two invented level cases; 3. separate vessel dimensions from navigation-approval data.
steps.observation: 船體在示意圖內放得下不代表符合實際通航條件。
steps.observationEn: A vessel fitting inside a drawing does not establish actual navigation eligibility.
steps.failure: 以滑鼠把船放入閘室就等於完成吃水與通航驗證。
steps.failureEn: Dragging a ship into a chamber completes draft and navigation verification.
steps.check: 提交幾何假設、情境與未知條件三欄表。
steps.checkEn: Provide geometric assumptions, scenarios and unknown conditions.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 船舶浮態與可用水深具有共同邊界，通航評估還需要營運及船舶資料。
knowledge.textEn: Vessel flotation and available depth share boundaries; navigation review also needs operating and vessel information.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本模型不提供允許吃水、船寬或實際航行建議。
knowledge.textEn: The model provides no permissible draft, beam or actual navigation advice.

quiz.question: 審查「檢查船舶包絡與水位情境」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Check vessel envelopes across level cases”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 以滑鼠把船放入閘室就等於完成吃水與通航驗證。
閘室土建尺寸可以直接取代營運者的船舶核准條件。
船體在示意圖內放得下不代表符合實際通航條件。
optionsEn: Dragging a ship into a chamber completes draft and navigation verification.
Chamber civil dimensions directly replace operator vessel-approval conditions.
A vessel fitting inside a drawing does not establish actual navigation eligibility.
quiz.explanation: 船舶浮態與可用水深具有共同邊界，通航評估還需要營運及船舶資料。 本模型不提供允許吃水、船寬或實際航行建議。
quiz.explanationEn: Vessel flotation and available depth share boundaries; navigation review also needs operating and vessel information. The model provides no permissible draft, beam or actual navigation advice.

steps.title: 把水位感測與設備狀態分開
steps.titleEn: Separate level sensing from equipment state
steps.objective: 理解量測與命令確認的不同證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand separate evidence for measurement and command confirmation.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫水位感測、控制判斷及設備回饋三個節點；2. 用不同箭頭標記資料和命令；3. 加入一個感測器失準的假想案例。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw level sensing, control decision and equipment-feedback nodes; 2. distinguish data from commands; 3. introduce a hypothetical sensor bias.
steps.observation: 發出命令與設備達到所需狀態是兩件需分別證實的事。
steps.observationEn: Issuing a command and reaching the required equipment state need separate evidence.
steps.failure: 控制畫面顯示命令已送出就能證明閘門機械位置正確。
steps.failureEn: A sent-command display proves the gate’s mechanical position is correct.
steps.check: 提供命令、回饋及獨立查證的功能圖。
steps.checkEn: Provide a function map of command, feedback and independent verification.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 控制系統依靠狀態資訊，感測偏差與回饋缺失需在概念驗證中區分。
knowledge.textEn: Controls rely on state information; biased sensing and missing feedback are distinct verification questions.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 此圖僅為一般工程原理，不揭示或模擬真實船閘控制邏輯。
knowledge.textEn: The diagram teaches general principles and neither reveals nor simulates actual lock-control logic.

quiz.question: 審查「把水位感測與設備狀態分開」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate level sensing from equipment state”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 發出命令與設備達到所需狀態是兩件需分別證實的事。
控制畫面顯示命令已送出就能證明閘門機械位置正確。
水位感測器正常就能證明閘門機械回饋也正常。
optionsEn: Issuing a command and reaching the required equipment state need separate evidence.
A sent-command display proves the gate’s mechanical position is correct.
A functioning level sensor proves correct mechanical gate feedback.
quiz.explanation: 控制系統依靠狀態資訊，感測偏差與回饋缺失需在概念驗證中區分。 此圖僅為一般工程原理，不揭示或模擬真實船閘控制邏輯。
quiz.explanationEn: Controls rely on state information; biased sensing and missing feedback are distinct verification questions. The diagram teaches general principles and neither reveals nor simulates actual lock-control logic.

steps.title: 建立水密試驗的證據結構
steps.titleEn: Structure evidence for a watertightness test
steps.objective: 區分試驗結果與試驗覆蓋範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish a test result from its coverage.
steps.instruction: 1. 選一個概念節水池邊界；2. 列出初始狀態、觀察量及資料期間；3. 明確寫下此次測試未涵蓋的介面。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Select a conceptual basin boundary; 2. list initial state, observations and record duration; 3. state interfaces outside this test.
steps.observation: 一次局部水密結果不能直接證明整個閘室系統所有功能。
steps.observationEn: One local watertightness result does not verify every function of the complete lock system.
steps.failure: 節水池不漏水便表示閘門、控制及通航全部已驗收。
steps.failureEn: A watertight basin means gates, controls and navigation are fully accepted.
steps.check: 輸出含邊界與不適用範圍的試驗摘要範本。
steps.checkEn: Provide a test-summary template with boundaries and exclusions.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 試驗論證需描述狀態、量測及判定依據；只有通過二字不足以追溯。
knowledge.textEn: A test argument needs state, observations and judgment basis; a bare pass label is not traceable.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 官方試水新聞提供建設里程碑，課程不由新聞反推實際驗收限值。
knowledge.textEn: Official filling-test news provides a milestone; this course does not infer acceptance limits from it.

quiz.question: 審查「建立水密試驗的證據結構」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Structure evidence for a watertightness test”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 節水池不漏水便表示閘門、控制及通航全部已驗收。
一次局部水密結果不能直接證明整個閘室系統所有功能。
試驗只需保留通過標記，不需保留當時邊界。
optionsEn: A watertight basin means gates, controls and navigation are fully accepted.
One local watertightness result does not verify every function of the complete lock system.
Testing needs only a pass label and no record of boundaries.
quiz.explanation: 試驗論證需描述狀態、量測及判定依據；只有通過二字不足以追溯。 官方試水新聞提供建設里程碑，課程不由新聞反推實際驗收限值。
quiz.explanationEn: A test argument needs state, observations and judgment basis; a bare pass label is not traceable. Official filling-test news provides a milestone; this course does not infer acceptance limits from it.

steps.title: 做跨專業整合審查
steps.objective: 讓土建、水力、機械與控制使用同一套邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Align boundaries across civil, hydraulic, mechanical and control disciplines.
steps.instruction: 1. 把四類系統放進介面矩陣；2. 每對介面填入共享量與版本；3. 追查一個水位基準變更的全部影響。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Place four system classes in an interface matrix; 2. record shared quantities and versions; 3. trace all effects of one level-datum change.
steps.observation: 共享水位基準不一致可能讓各自正確的子系統產生整體衝突。
steps.observationEn: Inconsistent shared level datums can make individually correct subsystems incompatible.
steps.failure: 每一專業自己的圖面通過就保證交界完全一致。
steps.failureEn: Every discipline’s drawing approval guarantees compatible interfaces.
steps.check: 提交一份含跨專業問題及修訂欄的矩陣。
steps.checkEn: Submit a matrix with multidisciplinary issues and revision fields.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 大型水工工程的錯誤常落在介面與資料定義，需明確協調責任與版本。
knowledge.textEn: Large hydraulic works need explicit responsibility and version control at interfaces and data definitions.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 介面審查不是實際系統投運許可；後者還需正式程序與專業驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Interface review is not permission to commission a real system, which requires formal procedures and professional verification.

quiz.question: 審查「做跨專業整合審查」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Review multidisciplinary integration”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 每一專業自己的圖面通過就保證交界完全一致。
土建與控制採用不同水位零點不會影響結果。
共享水位基準不一致可能讓各自正確的子系統產生整體衝突。
optionsEn: Every discipline’s drawing approval guarantees compatible interfaces.
Different level zero points in civil and control systems cannot affect results.
Inconsistent shared level datums can make individually correct subsystems incompatible.
quiz.explanation: 大型水工工程的錯誤常落在介面與資料定義，需明確協調責任與版本。 介面審查不是實際系統投運許可；後者還需正式程序與專業驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Large hydraulic works need explicit responsibility and version control at interfaces and data definitions. Interface review is not permission to commission a real system, which requires formal procedures and professional verification.

stages.title: 維護、流域與衍生工程
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「維護、流域與衍生工程」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on maintenance, watershed and related works, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 辨識密封劣化與量測誤差
steps.titleEn: Distinguish seal degradation and observation errors
steps.objective: 避免從單一滲漏數字推定唯一故障。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid inferring a unique fault from one leakage value.
steps.instruction: 1. 自設三段水位與流量紀錄；2. 分別加入密封變化、量測偏移及水位差變化；3. 找出需要獨立查證的訊號。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Create three level and flow records; 2. introduce seal changes, sensor offsets and changed head; 3. identify signals needing independent confirmation.
steps.observation: 流量增加可能來自水位差或量測改變，不一定只有密封劣化。
steps.observationEn: Higher flow can reflect changed head or measurements, not only seal degradation.
steps.failure: 只要漏水數字上升就能確定是哪一段密封失效。
steps.failureEn: An increased leakage number uniquely identifies the failed seal segment.
steps.check: 輸出至少三種原因的辨識表。
steps.checkEn: Produce a discrimination table for at least three causes.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 診斷需要把驅動條件與設備狀態一起比較，不能只看輸出數字。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnosis compares driving conditions with equipment state rather than output numbers alone.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 自設紀錄用於練習排除混淆因素，不代表任一真實閘門有缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Synthetic records practice separating confounders and imply no defect in any real gate.

quiz.question: 審查「辨識密封劣化與量測誤差」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Distinguish seal degradation and observation errors”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 流量增加可能來自水位差或量測改變，不一定只有密封劣化。
只要漏水數字上升就能確定是哪一段密封失效。
水位差改變不可能影響量到的漏水流量。
optionsEn: Higher flow can reflect changed head or measurements, not only seal degradation.
An increased leakage number uniquely identifies the failed seal segment.
Changed water head cannot affect observed leakage flow.
quiz.explanation: 診斷需要把驅動條件與設備狀態一起比較，不能只看輸出數字。 自設紀錄用於練習排除混淆因素，不代表任一真實閘門有缺陷。
quiz.explanationEn: Diagnosis compares driving conditions with equipment state rather than output numbers alone. Synthetic records practice separating confounders and imply no defect in any real gate.

steps.title: 建立維護可達性與備援觀點
steps.objective: 理解能維修與仍有服務能力是不同問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand that maintainability and retained service are separate questions.
steps.instruction: 1. 在概念系統標出待維護設備；2. 列出接近、隔離及其他路徑的證據需求；3. 分开局部備援與共同依賴。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Mark equipment for hypothetical maintenance; 2. list evidence needs for access, separation and alternate paths; 3. distinguish local redundancy from shared dependencies.
steps.observation: 兩套設備若共用同一個關鍵依賴，不代表完全獨立備援。
steps.observationEn: Two equipment sets sharing a critical dependency are not fully independent redundancy.
steps.failure: 設備數量加倍便可忽略共同供電或共同土建介面。
steps.failureEn: Doubling equipment count makes shared power or civil interfaces irrelevant.
steps.check: 繳交備援、共同原因與待查資料表。
steps.checkEn: Provide a table of redundancy, common causes and evidence gaps.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 可靠性要看功能路徑及共同失效因素，而非只數設備件數。
knowledge.textEn: Reliability depends on functional paths and common-cause factors, not equipment count alone.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本步不提供隔離、檢修或現場替代操作方法，只建立審查問題。
knowledge.textEn: This step provides no isolation, servicing or substitute operating method; it defines review questions.

quiz.question: 審查「建立維護可達性與備援觀點」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Review maintenance access and redundancy”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 設備數量加倍便可忽略共同供電或共同土建介面。
兩套設備若共用同一個關鍵依賴，不代表完全獨立備援。
兩個設備共用同一依賴仍必定構成完全獨立備援。
optionsEn: Doubling equipment count makes shared power or civil interfaces irrelevant.
Two equipment sets sharing a critical dependency are not fully independent redundancy.
Two devices sharing one dependency necessarily form fully independent redundancy.
quiz.explanation: 可靠性要看功能路徑及共同失效因素，而非只數設備件數。 本步不提供隔離、檢修或現場替代操作方法，只建立審查問題。
quiz.explanationEn: Reliability depends on functional paths and common-cause factors, not equipment count alone. This step provides no isolation, servicing or substitute operating method; it defines review questions.

steps.title: 把航次與流域資料分層
steps.objective: 連結局部節水與長期水資源帳。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect local reuse with long-term water-resource accounting.
steps.instruction: 1. 建立一次概念航次水帳；2. 另建月尺度入流、蒸發與取水帳；3. 標記兩者可比較與不可直接相加的量。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Create a conceptual transit water ledger; 2. create a monthly inflow, evaporation and withdrawal ledger; 3. mark comparable and nonadditive quantities.
steps.observation: 單次回用表現不能單獨代表整個流域的長期供需平衡。
steps.observationEn: Per-transit reuse alone does not establish long-term watershed balance.
steps.failure: 一個航次節水就能推出整個月水庫蓄水必然增加。
steps.failureEn: Water saving on one transit proves reservoir storage must rise over the month.
steps.check: 提交兩個時間尺度的守恆表與連結項。
steps.checkEn: Provide balances at two time scales with their connecting terms.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 水資源分析的時間與空間邊界必須一致；不同尺度的指標不能直接混算。
knowledge.textEn: Water-resource analysis needs consistent temporal and spatial boundaries; metrics at different scales cannot be mixed directly.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 長期判讀需資料完整性與不確定性，不由單次示範動畫推論。
knowledge.textEn: Long-term interpretation requires complete records and uncertainty treatment, not one demonstration animation.

quiz.question: 審查「把航次與流域資料分層」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate transit and watershed records”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 一個航次節水就能推出整個月水庫蓄水必然增加。
月尺度入流可以直接加到單次航次回用百分比。
單次回用表現不能單獨代表整個流域的長期供需平衡。
optionsEn: Water saving on one transit proves reservoir storage must rise over the month.
Monthly inflow can be added directly to a per-transit reuse percentage.
Per-transit reuse alone does not establish long-term watershed balance.
quiz.explanation: 水資源分析的時間與空間邊界必須一致；不同尺度的指標不能直接混算。 長期判讀需資料完整性與不確定性，不由單次示範動畫推論。
quiz.explanationEn: Water-resource analysis needs consistent temporal and spatial boundaries; metrics at different scales cannot be mixed directly. Long-term interpretation requires complete records and uncertainty treatment, not one demonstration animation.

steps.title: 比較原運河與其他升船工程
steps.titleEn: Compare the original canal and other ship-lifting works
steps.objective: 找出相近目的下不同水力與機械解法。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify different hydraulic and mechanical solutions to related aims.
steps.instruction: 1. 比較原巴拿馬船閘與擴建新閘；2. 再選三峽船閘或升船機查證；3. 分開水位調節、機械升降及資源需求。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Compare original and expanded Panama locks; 2. select Three Gorges locks or its ship lift for further evidence; 3. separate level adjustment, mechanical lifting and resource needs.
steps.observation: 都能升降船舶的工程仍可能有完全不同的承載與能源路徑。
steps.observationEn: Works that all raise vessels can have very different load and energy paths.
steps.failure: 所有升船設施都可用相同閘門及節水池模型表示。
steps.failureEn: Every ship-lifting facility can use the same gate and basin model.
steps.check: 繳交三個相似需求與三個不同機理。
steps.checkEn: Provide three shared needs and three different mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 衍生學習應比較要解決的問題，再查證各工程使用的具體方案。
knowledge.textEn: Related learning compares the problem first, then verifies the particular solution used by each project.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 原運河歷史是比較背景，不能把早期設備敘述當成擴建新閘的現況。
knowledge.textEn: Original-canal history provides comparison and must not be presented as current expanded-lock equipment.

quiz.question: 審查「比較原運河與其他升船工程」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Compare the original canal and other ship-lifting works”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 都能升降船舶的工程仍可能有完全不同的承載與能源路徑。
所有升船設施都可用相同閘門及節水池模型表示。
機械升船與調整閘室水位具有完全相同的能源路徑。
optionsEn: Works that all raise vessels can have very different load and energy paths.
Every ship-lifting facility can use the same gate and basin model.
Mechanical vessel lifting and chamber-level adjustment have identical energy paths.
quiz.explanation: 衍生學習應比較要解決的問題，再查證各工程使用的具體方案。 原運河歷史是比較背景，不能把早期設備敘述當成擴建新閘的現況。
quiz.explanationEn: Related learning compares the problem first, then verifies the particular solution used by each project. Original-canal history provides comparison and must not be presented as current expanded-lock equipment.

steps.title: 查核節水與容量宣稱
steps.objective: 把宣傳數字轉成可核對的工程敘述。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn headline numbers into checkable engineering statements.
steps.instruction: 1. 選一個官方容量或節水敘述；2. 摘出日期、比較對象與條件；3. 改寫成保留限制與未知的學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Select an official capacity or saving statement; 2. extract date, comparison basis and conditions; 3. rewrite it as a note retaining limits and unknowns.
steps.observation: 有來源的數字仍需保留日期與適用條件才不會被誤用。
steps.observationEn: A sourced number still needs its date and applicability conditions to avoid misuse.
steps.failure: 數字來自官方頁面就能不加條件套用到任何年份和航次。
steps.failureEn: An official number applies unconditionally to every year and transit.
steps.check: 提交一條原意不變且明示範圍的摘要。
steps.checkEn: Submit one faithful summary with explicit scope.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 資料可信與適用於當前問題是兩個不同檢查；來源權威不能取代邊界核對。
knowledge.textEn: Credibility and applicability are separate checks; source authority does not replace boundary review.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 使用者自設模擬結果不能偽裝成營運者的實際效率或性能保證。
knowledge.textEn: User-generated simulation results must not masquerade as operator efficiency data or performance guarantees.

quiz.question: 審查「查核節水與容量宣稱」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Audit water-saving and capacity claims”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 數字來自官方頁面就能不加條件套用到任何年份和航次。
有來源的數字仍需保留日期與適用條件才不會被誤用。
資料的發布日期與比較基準不影響工程宣稱的適用性。
optionsEn: An official number applies unconditionally to every year and transit.
A sourced number still needs its date and applicability conditions to avoid misuse.
Publication date and comparison basis do not affect a claim’s applicability.
quiz.explanation: 資料可信與適用於當前問題是兩個不同檢查；來源權威不能取代邊界核對。 使用者自設模擬結果不能偽裝成營運者的實際效率或性能保證。
quiz.explanationEn: Credibility and applicability are separate checks; source authority does not replace boundary review. User-generated simulation results must not masquerade as operator efficiency data or performance guarantees.

steps.title: 完成水工系統交付報告
steps.objective: 讓幾何、水量、設備與資料保持一致。
steps.objectiveEn: Align geometry, water balance, equipment and evidence.
steps.instruction: 1. 彙整四階段模型及矩陣；2. 逐一連結來源、假設與未解項；3. 選一個介面變更演練資料更新的傳播。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Assemble four-stage models and matrices; 2. link sources, assumptions and open items; 3. rehearse propagation of one interface revision.
steps.observation: 可複查報告會清楚指出自設模型與真實工程證據的分界。
steps.observationEn: An auditable report clearly separates invented models from real-project evidence.
steps.failure: 完成全部動畫就可宣稱已掌握真實船閘的投運與操控。
steps.failureEn: Completing all animations establishes mastery of real lock commissioning and control.
steps.check: 提交含版本、圖例、來源與待查問題的學習檔。
steps.checkEn: Submit a learning dossier with versions, legends, sources and open questions.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 水工巨作需要土建、機械、水力、控制及流域共同成立，局部示範不等於整體驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Major hydraulic works depend on civil, mechanical, hydraulic, control and watershed systems together; a local demo is not system verification.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本課程交付的是工程概念與證據組織能力，不是現場建造或操作資格。
knowledge.textEn: The deliverable is engineering understanding and evidence organization, not field construction or operating qualification.

quiz.question: 審查「完成水工系統交付報告」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Complete the hydraulic-system learning report”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 完成全部動畫就可宣稱已掌握真實船閘的投運與操控。
每個局部功能動畫成功就等同整體正式驗收完成。
可複查報告會清楚指出自設模型與真實工程證據的分界。
optionsEn: Completing all animations establishes mastery of real lock commissioning and control.
Successful local animations equal completion of formal system acceptance.
An auditable report clearly separates invented models from real-project evidence.
quiz.explanation: 水工巨作需要土建、機械、水力、控制及流域共同成立，局部示範不等於整體驗證。 本課程交付的是工程概念與證據組織能力，不是現場建造或操作資格。
quiz.explanationEn: Major hydraulic works depend on civil, mechanical, hydraulic, control and watershed systems together; a local demo is not system verification. The deliverable is engineering understanding and evidence organization, not field construction or operating qualification.
